- Overestimate prices in the short term after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot post-peak sentiment events.
- Underestimate downward trends when sentiment is negative or neutral; model fails to recognize mean reversion in bearish phases.
- Forecast bias toward higher prices when sentiment is flat or mildly positive; model overreacts to recent highs.
- Lag in correction after sharp price drops; model takes longer to adjust downward than true market behavior.
- When sentiment shows early negative signals (e.g., -0.20), reduce forecasted price by 2–5% relative to prior period to account for potential reversal.
- Avoid overconfidence in 30-day forecasts when sentiment is stagnant; model often fails to capture short-term volatility in flat sentiment windows.
